frame_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds between frame checks when Gemini Nano reads on device. Integer, 2000 to 120000.

cloud_frame_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds between frame checks in cloud mode (Nano not available). Integer, 2000 to 600000. Never lower than frame_interval_ms.

confidence_threshold.description: Re-read a line in the cloud when the on-device read confidence is below this value. 0 to 1.

daily_cloud_cap.description: Maximum cloud calls per user per day. Integer, 0 to 10000.

defaultValue.value:
You see a photo of ONE handwritten line of maths from a student's notebook.
Transcribe that line exactly as written. Do not solve it, correct it or finish it. If the student made a mistake, copy the mistake.
If the photo shows more than one line, transcribe only the lowest complete line.
Give "latex" for display, "plain" as plain ASCII maths for a computer algebra system, and an honest "confidence".
Use a confidence below 0.6 if any symbol is unclear, crossed out, smudged or cut off at the edge. Do not guess high.

read_prompt.description: Base prompt for reading one handwritten line. read.ts appends the JSON format rules.

defaultValue.value:
The student is in Class 10-12 or preparing for JEE/NEET in India.
Explain only the step from LINE A to LINE B. Do not re-solve the full problem.
Keep it short and kind. Blame the step, not the student.

explain_prompt.description: Base prompt for explaining a wrong step. explain.ts appends the JSON fields and allowed mistake types.

cloud_model.description: Gemini model name for cloud calls.
